blockers: A1 — The common author harness is not the frozen born-RED corpus. It accepts a parser with reproducible plus, fraction, and signed-exponent semantic defects and cannot encode expected failures, predecessor/diagnostic transactionality, composition, or the bound hostile/work-limit matrix. Four authors may not begin against a six-success smoke oracle.

A2 — The comparator boundary substitutes retyped bare regex adapters for execution of the bound live, deposed parse-that, and C14 CST implementations, and then derives peer-specific semantic intersections. These bytes cannot support the required strict retained-iteration claims; bind executable peer operations or classify non-equivalent peers NON_COMPARABLE without borrowing their names.

A3 — G10 has no executable post-challenge admission or author-close contract. Actor/task identity, isolation prompts, candidate-root paths, input manifests, author receipts, and disjointness are deferred to an unbound manual `author-task-witness.json`; the combined public topology file also exposes every seat design in the shared workspace. The exact subject therefore cannot safely authorize four isolated authors.

A4 — The zero-candidate census still misses mode-0644 importable extensionless modules under the exact tsx execution regime and freezes no candidate roots. Its zero count over 39 rows is not the exhaustive pre-author absence claim required by the boundary.

A5 — The formation is content-addressed but not continuity-sealed, all 12 rows are writable, and the only exact validator deliberately stops once the holdout exists. There is no current-subject validator to join formation, holdout, both substantive challenges, external task receipts, and the future author witness before dispatch.

A6 — The advertised candidate harness depends on unledgered installed tsx bytes. The parse-that package closure is complete, but the executable correctness environment is not, so candidate results are not fully reproducible from the exact boundary.

disposition.required_next: Do not dispatch G10 authors from this subject. A new exact boundary must make the already-bound public corpus executable, bind faithful comparator operations and the full harness runtime, close the census, and provide one mechanical external-receipt-aware author admission before any candidate write.
